title: Fil Frens
tagline: Fil Frens is an innovative web app to discover addresses on FVM. By submitting an address, the user can explore the ENS address, domain, and chat with the user. forge new friendships directly with address holders.

prizes.placement: 🥇 Beryx — Best use of Beryx API
prizes.title: Beryx

description: Fil Frens is a web application that enables users to discover addresses on the Ethereum Name Service (ENS) in a convenient and user-friendly way. By submitting an address, users can explore the associated ENS address, domain, and initiate chat conversations with the address holder. It aims to facilitate connections and friendships among Ethereum address holders, fostering a sense of community within the platform. Fil Frens provides a straightforward interface for users to navigate and connect with others in the Ethereum ecosystem, promoting collaboration and meaningful interactions.
how_its_made:
In our project, we implemented Beryx in order to seamlessly obtain on-chain data from the FVM (Fast Virtual Machine). Additionally, we employed the wagmi framework to establish secure connections between wallets, facilitating smooth interactions within the web app. To enhance user experience, we leveraged the power of ENS (Ethereum Name Service) to display user names associated with their respective addresses, adding a personal touch to the overall interface.

Furthermore, the push protocol was also utilized for video calls, enabling real-time communication and seamless video streaming within our application. To achieve a visually appealing design, we opted for a combination of Tailwind and DaisyUI, which provided an efficient and flexible styling solution for our NextJS web application. Moreover, the use of Typescript throughout the development process ensured strong type safety, enhancing code reliability and reducing potential errors.
